dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Nam, can you check my speech? I'm not sure about the grammar.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, kən juː ˈtʃɛk maɪ ˈspiːtʃ? aɪm ˈnɑːt ˈʃʊr əˈbaʊt ðə ˈɡræmər.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Sure. Here you wrote, "The number of young people without jobs are growing." It should be "is growing."
dialogue.reading: ˈʃʊr. ˈhɪr juː ˈroʊt, ðə ˈnʌmbər əv ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl wɪˈðaʊt ˈdʒɑːbz ər ˈɡroʊɪŋ. ɪt ʃʊd bi ˈɪz ˈɡroʊɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Exactly. And use "the amount of" for things you can't count, like water or money.
dialogue.reading: ɪɡˈzæktli. ənd ˈjuːz ði əˈmaʊnt əv fər ˈθɪŋz juː ˈkænt ˈkaʊnt, ˈlaɪk ˈwɔːtər ɔːr ˈmʌni.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Got it. By the way, what's the birth rate like in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ˈɡɑːt ɪt. ˈbaɪ ðə ˈweɪ, ˈwʌts ðə ˈbɜːrθ ˌreɪt ˈlaɪk ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's falling every year. Last year, the number of babies born in Thailand was under 500,000.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈfɔːlɪŋ ˈɛvri ˈjɪr. ˈlæst ˈjɪr, ðə ˈnʌmbər əv ˈbeɪbiz ˈbɔːrn ɪn ˈtaɪlænd wʌz ˈʌndər ˈfaɪv ˈhʌndrəd ˈθaʊzənd.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Really? But the world's population is still growing, isn't it?
dialogue.reading: ˈriːli? bʌt ðə ˈwɜːrldz ˌpɑːpjəˈleɪʃən ɪz ˈstɪl ˈɡroʊɪŋ, ˈɪzənt ɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. There are approximately eight billion people now.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ðɛr ər əˈprɑːksɪmətli ˈeɪt ˈbɪljən ˈpiːpəl ˈnaʊ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: But the growth rate is slowing down, right?
dialogue.reading: bʌt ðə ˈɡroʊθ ˌreɪt ɪz ˈsloʊɪŋ ˈdaʊn, ˈraɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Right. But the amount of food we need is still rising.
dialogue.reading: ˈraɪt. bʌt ði əˈmaʊnt əv ˈfuːd wiː ˈniːd ɪz ˈstɪl ˈraɪzɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: And is youth unemployment a problem in Thailand?
dialogue.reading: ənd ɪz ˈjuːθ ˌʌnɪmˈplɔɪmənt ə ˈprɑːbləm ɪn ˈtaɪlænd?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It's not too bad. But I think the number of young people who want to work abroad is increasing.
dialogue.reading: ɪts ˈnɑːt ˈtuː ˈbæd. bʌt aɪ ˈθɪŋk ðə ˈnʌmbər əv ˈjʌŋ ˈpiːpəl huː ˈwɑːnt tə ˈwɜːrk əˈbrɔːd ɪz ɪnˈkriːsɪŋ.
